qualification: Synthetic longitudinal model audit. It does not represent 10,000 human participants or prove real retention, satisfaction or commercial outcomes.
isolation: Local deterministic execution only. No production accounts, photos, APIs, Supabase rows, provider calls or personal data are read or written.

performance.qualification: In-process algorithm time, not backend load or mobile latency.

conclusions.recommendation: La calibracion por confianza conserva el ranking y reduce el error de afinidad; puede avanzar a regresion de producto y paridad Edge. La recencia adaptativa queda rechazada porque la señal de deriva no separa perfiles estables y cambiantes con recall suficiente.

methodology.agents: Five engagement segments with latent five-axis palates, noisy onboarding answers, budgets, contexts and optional taste drift.
methodology.chronology: Each agent is evaluated in event order. Only feedback available before an event trains that event recommendation.
methodology.feedback: Current and candidate policies receive the same feedback opportunity and experience noise; each learns only from its own prior recommendations.
methodology.candidateSets: 24 synthetic wines sampled per decision from a 180-wine catalog.

baselines.popularity: Static catalog popularity independent of simulated feedback.
baselines.onboarding: Initial Matchrim test profile with no longitudinal learning.
baselines.hybrid: Current Matchrim calculateLearnedMatchrimProfile and affinity ranking.
baselines.candidate: Current ranking with confidence-aware affinity calibration. Preference-shift telemetry is measured, but adaptive forgetting is disabled.
baselines.oracle: Evaluation ceiling using latent taste, context and budget; never visible to the hybrid model.

knownLimits: Synthetic responses inherit the assumptions encoded in the simulator.
The current five-axis model cannot represent grape, region, oak, aroma families or explicit occasion preferences.
Vision/OCR identity quality is evaluated by the separate recognition benchmark, not fabricated here.
Real-world retention, trust and willingness to pay require a consented human pilot.
